summary_1line: Yudhishthira questions why wealth seems governed by fate rather than effort; Bhishma replies that effort, charity, and righteousness still shape future outcomes and purity of soul.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yudhishthira sits beside the arrow-pierced Bhishma on the battlefield, questioning him about fate and effort as warriors stand silently around.
Bhishma lies upon a bed of arrows beneath the open sky, calmly instructing Yudhishthira about charity, nonviolence, and righteousness.
